source.objectiveEnglishInternal: explain time pressure, ask what is fastest, and confirm preparation time
source.roleplayEnglishInternal: You have twelve minutes before a tour; ask for a realistic fast option.

readerVerbExamples.target: Tengo prisa porque mi tour sale en 12 minutos.
readerVerbExamples.native: I'm in a hurry because my tour leaves in 12 minutes.
He asks for the bill now.

readerVerbExamples.target: La cocina prepara el café americano rápido.
readerVerbExamples.native: The kitchen prepares the americano coffee quickly.

archivedDraft.scene: Sam has a tour meeting soon and asks a café worker for a realistic breakfast option.

sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: bill, check (the slip of paper showing what you owe)

sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: Used after the food or drink you order.
sourceCards.japaneseUsageNoteInternal: Place 持ち帰りで after the item ordered; テイクアウト is a common alternative.
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: takeout, taking it with you ("to go")

sourceCards.japaneseUsageNoteInternal: The source specifies a female waitress; ウェイター names a waiter.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Tengo prisa porque mi tour sale pronto.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: I'm in a hurry because my tour leaves soon.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: ツアーがもうすぐ出発するので、急いでいます。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: (My) tour leaves soon, so I'm in a hurry.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: ¿Qué es lo más rápido que tienen?
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: What is the fastest thing you have?
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 一番早く出せるものは何ですか。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: What is the thing you can serve the fastest?

sourceCards.sourceEnglish: How long does the preparation take?
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 準備にはどのくらい時間がかかりますか。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: How long does the preparation take?

sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Could it be to go, please?
sourceCards.japaneseUsageNoteInternal: 〜お願いできますか is a polite request; check register in the complete exchange.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 持ち帰りでお願いできますか。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Could I ask for it to go?

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: ¿Me trae la cuenta ahora, por favor?
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Could you bring me the bill now, please?
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 今、伝票を持ってきていただけますか。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Could you bring (me) the bill now?

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Un viajero entra a un café a las 8:00 y habla con la mesera en el mostrador.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: A traveler walks into a café at 8:00 and talks with the waitress at the counter.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 旅行者が8時にカフェに入り、カウンターでウェイトレスと話します。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: A traveler enters a café at 8:00 and talks with the waitress at the counter.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Él dice: Tengo prisa porque mi tour sale en 12 minutos.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: He says: I'm in a hurry because my tour leaves in 12 minutes.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 彼は「ツアーが12分後に出発するので、急いでいます」と言います。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: He says, "(My) tour leaves in 12 minutes, so I'm in a hurry."

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Pregunta: ¿Qué es lo más rápido que tienen para el desayuno?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: He asks: What is the fastest thing you have for breakfast?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 「朝食に一番早く出せるものは何ですか」と尋ねます。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: (He) asks, "What is the thing you can serve the fastest for breakfast?"

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: La mesera responde que un sándwich de huevo y un café americano salen rápido.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: The waitress answers that an egg sandwich and an americano come out quickly.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ウェイトレスは、エッグサンドとアメリカーノがすぐに出せると答えます。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: The waitress answers that an egg sandwich and an americano can be served quickly.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: El viajero pregunta: ¿Cuánto tiempo tarda la preparación del sándwich?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: The traveler asks: How long does the sandwich take to prepare?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 旅行者は「サンドイッチの準備にはどのくらい時間がかかりますか」と尋ねます。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: The traveler asks, "How long does the preparation of the sandwich take?"

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Ella dice que tarda unos 5 minutos, según la cocina.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: She says it takes about 5 minutes, according to the kitchen.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 彼女は、厨房の話では5分ほどかかると言います。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: She says that, according to the kitchen, it takes about five minutes.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Si es posible, él quiere el desayuno para llevar, porque no tiene tiempo para sentarse.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: If it is possible, he wants breakfast to go, because he has no time to sit down.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 彼は座る時間がないので、できれば朝食を持ち帰りにしたいと思っています。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: He has no time to sit down, so if possible he wants to have breakfast to go.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: También pide la cuenta ahora para pagar en el mostrador.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: He also asks for the bill now so he can pay at the counter.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: また彼は、カウンターで支払えるように、今伝票を持ってきてほしいと頼みます。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: He also asks (her) to bring the bill now so that he can pay at the counter.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: La mesera sonríe y dice: Con gusto, enseguida se lo preparo.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: The waitress smiles and says: My pleasure, I'll get it ready for you right away.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ウェイトレスはほほえんで、「はい、喜んで。すぐにご用意します」と言います。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: The waitress smiles and says, "Yes, gladly. I'll get it ready right away."

japaneseSpecificFocusCandidate: Explain a 12-minute tour deadline; ask about the fastest egg-sandwich and americano order, five-minute preparation, takeout, and immediate bill.
speakingGoalInternal: You have twelve minutes before a tour; ask for a realistic fast option.
sourceConflictInternal: The current source has an unnamed traveler and female waitress at 8:00, an egg sandwich and americano, a five-minute kitchen estimate, takeout, and payment at the counter before a tour. The archived draft changes the food to a rice ball, invents Sam and a busy-kitchen caveat, and omits source lines. Keep source objective separate from Japanese literal glosses.

savedPositionPolicy: Archived draft rows have no explicit stable row IDs and were not registered. Revision-scoped candidate IDs do not authorize saved-item or audio placement migration. Reordering requires a new revision.
reviewQuestionsInternal: The source is an unnamed café with a female waitress; retain the 8:00 entry, tour in 12 minutes, egg sandwich and americano, five-minute preparation, takeout and counter payment without adding Japan-specific service facts.
Check 伝票 as the bill document against お会計 as the act of settling payment; Card 18 and Reader 8 use the same bill-document sense.
The source Spanish según la cocina and English according to the kitchen are retained as 厨房の話では; a source editor should confirm that intent rather than depending on kitchen workload.
Check ウェイトレス for dated register while preserving the source female staff reference; use ウェイター only for a waiter in a later note.
Add Japanese learner notes for 持ち帰りで after the item, 〜お願いできますか as a polite request, and 分 counter readings before any learner use.
Review エッグサンド and アメリカーノ as source food/drink names, without substituting rice balls or a local coffee style.
The archived draft has no stable card/Reader IDs and changes the food to a rice ball; old positions do not migrate to these candidates.
